text:
Lewiston reports 1 scam for week ending June 27, 2026
For the week ending June 27, 2026, Lewiston reported one scam, according to Better Business Bureau.
No scams were reported in the city the previous week.
One report included dollar amounts, with reported losses totaling $45.
The largest reported loss that week was $45 in a case classified as counterfeit product. The report noted: "I PURCHASED WHAT I THOUGHT WERE FACE MASKS FOR ATV RIDES AND WHEN I RECEIVED THEM THEY WERE DOLLAR STORE QUALITY ..CHEAP THIN PLASTIC..NOT WHAT WAS ADVERTISED.."
BBB Scam Tracker lets consumers search reported scams and share their experiences to help others spot similar schemes. The BBB says it reviews each report before publication and does not publicly display the reporter’s name or personal contact information.
Fraud reports nationwide have continued to involve large financial losses. The Federal Trade Commission said consumers reported losing more than $12.5 billion to fraud in 2024, a 25% increase from the previous year.
